notes.title: HAPPY HOLIDAYS!
notes.content: With this quick Christmas-themed update, we’d like to wish everyone who played Nightshift Survival this year happy holidays and a fantastic 2025! We look forward to receiving your valuable feedback to make our game even better. Big news is coming next year, including Night 3, which will be in production soon!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1.4 HALLOWEEN
notes.content:
Hello! Halloween is here, and we've brought you a new update full of treats - the tricks are left to the creatures of Millennium Park ;)

[b]UPDATED BAN SYSTEM[/b]
When banning an item on the Level Up screen, you'll still be able to choose one of the other selected items. We believe this option will now be much more useful without impacting the players' build.

[b]THEMED SCENERY[/b]
Millennium Park is fully decorated to celebrate this spooky season!

See you in the next update!

notes.title: PRICE ADJUSTMENT!
notes.content:
Hello everyone :) We would like to inform you that next week, Nightshift Survival will have its price adjusted.

This decision was made after much thought, based on player feedback, market research, and conversations with partners, aiming to ensure better scalability for our team to bring the game to even higher levels of quality and content. This way, we will be able to develop everything we intend to release in future updates with more security and agility.

[b]If you have already purchased the game, nothing changes: your access to the new base content that will be released in the future here on Steam is lifetime and with no additional cost! And if you haven’t purchased it yet, there’s still time.[/b]

We will continue working to meet your suggestions, feedback, criticisms, and to keep delivering a fun and high-quality game to everyone.

We greatly appreciate the understanding and support of the entire Nightshift Survival community!

There’s much more to come.

notes.title: BUG FIX 1.1.3
notes.content:
Hello!

We have received reports from some players experiencing issues with game startup. After investigating, we identified the error and have already fixed it. It was related to retrieving the language settings from players' Steam accounts.

We hope everyone can now enjoy this new update. We'll continue to keep an eye on your feedback! ;)

notes.title: Come and experience Millennium Park's newest attraction, Happy Mode!
notes.content:
Hello!

First of all, we would like to thank everyone who played Nightshift Survival this year and who collaborated with so much feedback. Today we are launching our[b] Christmas themed version 1.0.7[/b], with amazing news!!

We added new options in the settings menu that allow for better regulation of image filters. We received some very important feedback in this direction and we hope that now the players' experience will be more enjoyable :)

We added German support - stay tuned for more localizations!

[h1][b]THE NEW HAPPY MODE[/b][/h1]

Surviving the night is not enough: test your limits behind the Happy Points and discover new secrets...

We are looking forward to next year. Stay tuned! [b]Happy holidays![/b]

notes.title: Night Zero's Arrival......
notes.content:
Hey guys
Today we are releasing our version 1.0.6, responding to some of the feedback you gave us!

Firstly, you will now be able to select another weapon to start your night, if you survived until 3am the night before! You can choose between a good old umbrella or another random weapon.

We've also rebalanced some of the weapons, like the soccer ball, party balloon and plane. Try it!

And finally, we created an introduction to the mysteries of Millennium Park. If you start a new save, you will be able to play and experience the new intro scene. But if you already have a saved game and don't want to reset your progress, don't worry: in the next updates you will be able to try or replay this introduction ;)
